purpose: Three new prospective infrastructure trials; earlier cron failures and successful push diagnostic remain separate evidence
trigger: Start and install before the fixed intent. Third early cron wakes six hours before its fixed next-day intent; sender waits at most one hour before dispatching a runner at most five hours early. Timing remains unproven.
failure_policy: Keep every failure, uncertain request and missing intent. No automatic retry, owner takeover, favorable selection or retrospective date replacement.
activation: Only this entire named cohort plus the latest-three/two-UTC-date gate can authorize a committed future scientific registration. Previous failures are retained, not relabeled.
